Evelyn: quick follow-up from the postmortem: collecting the short DR action items we need before the regional failover rehearsal. planning a 60m tabletop + 90m live dry-run next Wed 09:30 PT. please claim tasks and ETA.
Marco: i'll own route-preference audits and the pre-game route-diff script. will add an automated check for local-pref regressions. due Tue EOD.
Ravi: i'll update restore_playbook.md with explicit timings, rollback steps, and the snapshot integrity checklist. will include the S3 verification snippet. due Tue EOD.
Hannah: i can take the canary traffic plan + dashboard widgets for restore_progress and token-cache warmup. will also add a throttled reconnect helper. due Tue EOD.
Evelyn: interim deadlines: scripts + runbook updates by Tue EOD, dry-run rehearsal Wed 09:30, live failover Thu 10:00 if rehearsal passes.
Marco: recurring pattern note: BGP flaps correlate with new prefix announcements during autoscale. adding pre-check: compare AS-path and local-pref before accepting announcements.
Ravi: snippet for manifest check i'll add:
```
aws s3api head-object --bucket redwood-backups-prod --key snapshots/$(date -I)/manifest.json || exit 2
jq -r .checksums manifest.json | sha256sum -c - || exit 3
```
Hannah: canary plan: 2% traffic to failover region, monitor 5xx and p99 tail. abort if p99 > 500ms or error > 0.8% for 5m. will post PR for test harness today.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: rehearsal Wed 09:00 PT; checklist will post 30m prior.
Evelyn: please react with ":white_check_mark:" to accept. also add estimated hours on the tracker cards. i'll compile and close this thread tomorrow.
Marco: :white_check_mark: 3h estimate.
Ravi: :white_check_mark: 4h estimate.
Hannah: :white_check_mark: 4h estimate; will open PR for dashboard widgets tonight.
Evelyn: thanks everyone. moving actions into the postmortem tracker and scheduling invites.
